def resource_gen(name, limit=None):
    """Yields items 0,1,2,...; on close/cleanup, appends to cleanup_log.
    Appends '{name}:done' then '{name}:yielded={count}'.
    If limit is set, stops after limit items. Cleanup always runs."""
